description: This file defines a Java interface for a repository managing QrSession entities, extending Spring Data JPA's JpaRepository and providing a custom method to find a QrSession by session token.
external_methods: JpaRepository's standard methods (save, findById, delete, etc.)

classes.name: QrSessionRepository

methods.name: findBySessionToken
methods.description: Retrieve an Optional containing the QrSession entity that matches the provided session token.
